- Our revenue team requires a valid PO number + invoice before month-end close.
- If the invoice lands after May 20 we can still attempt a late posting but it risks falling into June.
- If the PO arrives but with nonstandard terms (e.g., 90-day payment terms) that can create an accounting hold; let us know if legal asks for specific wording.
